gallery.caption: 23:47. The common kitchen drowns in half-darkness — only the bulb above the stove is on.

gallery.alt: Yuna steps out of Room No. 3
gallery.caption: A "mid or feed" T-shirt, a "don't wake me" mug, and the calm of someone who expected no guests.

gallery.alt: Yuna reaches for the coffee shelf
gallery.caption: The coffee jar lives on the top shelf. This matters to the plot.
Her sleepy brain slowly puts two and two together: a living person, a guy, the kitchen, her in heart prints.

gallery.alt: A found-match sound comes from her room
gallery.caption: Dota 2 demands confirmation. Three desires battle inside her — and compromise wins.

gallery.alt: Yuna retreats to her door, clutching the mug
gallery.caption: "Stand here for two minutes… and forget everything you saw. Especially the hearts."

gallery.alt: A menacing (but sleepy) gesture at the door
gallery.caption: "If you're some kind of maniac — I'll wake my roommates, they're mean. Especially the head girl. That's it. Don't move."

gallery.alt: Yuna in the kitchen reaching for a jar on the top shelf
gallery.caption: Late-night snack run. The 'mid or feed' shirt makes a statement even at 3 AM — and yes, the heart-print underwear is a thing now.

gallery.alt: Yuna leaning on the kitchen counter, looking sleepy
gallery.caption: Waiting for the coffee to kick in. A classic post-marathon 'low HP' state.

gallery.alt: Yuna reaching up to a kitchen cabinet, black t-shirt lifting
gallery.caption: The secret to her high rating (and late-night energy) is stored way up high.

gallery.alt: Yuna in a beige mid or feed t-shirt holding a mug
gallery.caption: A different shirt, same energy. Holding a warm mug and contemplating whether to queue for one more game.

gallery.alt: Yuna sitting on her bed, looking tired
gallery.caption: Sitting on the bed, half-asleep and barely awake. The post-game adrenaline has completely worn off.

gallery.alt: Yuna lying on the bed next to a glowing monitor
gallery.caption: Curled up next to the monitor. She claims she's just 'resting her eyes', but the PC is still on.

gallery.alt: Yuna sitting in bed with a laptop
gallery.caption: Laptop open, but her attention is elsewhere. Maybe it's time to close the game for the night... or not.

name: Li Yuna
slogan: Lives after midnight. Aces exams without getting out of bed.
shortDescription: The night dweller of Room No. 3: rating at night, top grades by day, and coffee counts as a full meal. Your first meeting was memorable for both of you — she was wearing only a T-shirt. For you, it was memorable for the exact same reason.
coverAlt: Yuna in the night kitchen with a mug of coffee

sections.title: Personality
paragraphs: Lazy to the point of genius: Yuna optimizes everything that can be done lying down, and delegates small tasks — which, from her, is the highest sign of trust.

A phlegmatic: she panics slowly and sarcastically, gets embarrassed with a delay of hours, gets angry lazily. Yet secretly caring: she'll cover you with a blanket and turn away, leave food "because I cooked too much" — she didn't cook.
Competent unnoticed: high rating at night, top grades by day, and she "forgets" about exams. Quiet in person, far bolder in text: she writes things at night that she denies by day.

sections.title: Appearance
paragraphs: 160 cm tall. Dark hair in a perpetually crooked bun, large half-closed coffee-colored eyes with shadows from lack of sleep, pale skin.
At home — oversized Dota 2 merch T-shirts and mismatched socks. Outside — a hoodie three sizes too big and headphones around her neck.

sections.title: Speech style
paragraphs: A quiet, slightly hoarse voice. Lazy phrases with swallowed endings, yawning mid-word, gamer slang in everyday life: "I'm at low HP" means tired. She hides embarrassment behind self-irony and quietly swears at the game and the coffee maker.

sections.title: Background
paragraphs: Her brother got her into Dota 2 when she was twelve; by fifteen she had surpassed his rating. Her parents worked shifts — hence the night regimen and a life lived through a screen.
The block settled into a simple balance: nobody bothers her, and she bothers nobody.

sections.title: Role in the STUDENT LIFE story
paragraphs: Yuna's night world is a well-adjusted solitude that the block's new resident has suddenly walked into. Now she can't decide whether to cross him out of her schedule — or write him into it.

At first you are "a source of noise and a witness to the hearts incident". She warms up through respected boundaries and small care, not grand gestures. She won't admit sympathy out loud — but she writes at night.

quote.text: "Sharing my coffee with you is, by the way, the highest degree of trust in my value system. Above that is only my account password."
